product.title: Sagrada Familia and Guell Park Small Group Tour: Drink and Tapa

description.text: In Barcelona, see two of Antoni Gaudí’s masterpieces in just a few hours with this small-group tour with a local, English speaking guide. Includes transport between the two sites and a drink and tapas at the end of the tour. Stops include Park Güell, Sagrada Familia. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so visitors can focus on Gaudí architecture, Mediterranean views, and neighborhood walking or cycling highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
